screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tomahawk Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Cavalry veteran Sgt. Wade McCoy immediately butts heads with his new supervisor, Lt. Jonathan Davenport, over the latter's lack of experience on the treacherous route known as the "Tomahawk Trail," but Davenport's unfamiliarity with the territory proves deadly when a trip to Fort Bowie finds the troop under Apache attack. Crazy from the heat, Davenport turns on his men, forcing McCoy to go against his commanding officer in order to save the lives of others. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Captain John Smith and Pocahontas
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Back in England after his trip to Jamestown, Va., Capt. John Smith (Anthony Dexter) tells the tale of his journey, particularly his lost romance with Native American maiden Pocahontas (Jody Lawrence). They meet and gradually fall for each other when captured Smith is saved from certain death by the girl. But as Smith tries to maintain peace between the British colonists and local tribes, the task proves harrowing, and Smith's friend Rolfe (Robert Clarke) begins to move in on Pocahontas. (Historical drama) - 1953

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Grayeagle
screenpixwesterns.us.description: One day while reputable trapper John Colter (Ben Johnson) is away from home, his adoring daughter Beth (Lana Wood) is captured by the notorious Indian Grayeagle (Alex Cord). But, as her father begins his tireless search to recover her, Beth is surprised to discover that there is more to Grayeagle than his fearsome reputation would imply. As she grows to realize that he is a man of honor -- much like her father -- she begins to fall in love with this proud Cheyenne warrior. (Western) - 1977

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Yellow Tomahawk
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After commanding the brutal slaughter of a Cheyenne tribe, callous cavalry leader Maj. Ives (Warner Anderson) then orders the construction of a military base on Native American territory. While the surviving Cheyenne men plot their revenge, warrior Fireknife (Lee Van Cleef) contacts his friend cavalry scout Adam Reed (Rory Calhoun), and warns him of the bloodbath that will occur if Ives doesn't retreat from the area. Reed passes on the message, which falls on deaf ears, and chaos ensues. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Iroquois Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War. (Western) - 1950

screenpixwesterns.us.title: War Drums
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether to return when war with the Apaches erupts. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Marble Slab
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Looking to obtain evidence to convict a gang, Pinkerton hires Bat to go undercover; posing as a marble salesman, Bat attempts to convince the gang's leader to commission a statue of himself for the town square. (Western) - 1961-05-11

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Farmer With a Badge
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A farmer-turned-marshal rescues Bat after bandits leave him for dead; Bat helps the lawman find confidence in his new position as peacekeeper. (Western) - 1961-05-18

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Black Diamond
screenpixwesterns.us.description: As silver strikes increase, more miners are robbed and murdered, forcing Hollister to hunt down the killers; a stolen black diamond turns out to be a clue in the crimes. (Western) - 1959-04-17

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Man From Brewster
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A young man enters the sheriff's office wanting help for being accused of gold robbery in Brewster. (Western) - 1959-04-24

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Ride Back
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Determined to redeem his life as a failure, Sheriff Chris Hamish crosses the Mexican border to find an outlaw named Kallen and extradite him to Texas for a fair trial. Hamish arrests Kallen, who doubts the sheriff's ability to bring him to justice and makes several attempts to escape. But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Barquero
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues. (Western, Drama) - 1970

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Hunting Party
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank. (Western) - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Scalphunters
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalp hunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man. (Western, Comedy) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Blood Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the 1890s California, Sicilian winemakers battle with a railroad tycoon over control of the land. William Berrigan will stop at nothing to get what he wants -- a train track running through the valley. Standing in his way is the Collogero family: father Sebastian, son Marco, and daughter Maria. But Berrigan makes a misjudgment when he orders the death of Sebastian, which launches a blood war in the vine-strangled hills. (Western) - 1989

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Street
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Frank Bogan (Warren Kemmerling), a violent criminal sentenced to the death penalty, escapes from prison and vows revenge against those he blames for his capture. Local sheriff Chuck Morton (James Brown) is tasked with warning Bogan's likely victims. At the top of Morton's list are Bogan's ex-wife, Janice (Peggy Stewart) ; her new husband, Dr. Dean Knudtson (John Pickard) ; and Jeff Baxley (Herb Armstrong), whose testimony in court helped convict Bogan. (Western, Drama) - 1961

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. (Fantasy) - 1995

showtimewomen.us.title: Love, Rosie
showtimewomen.us.description: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles. (Romantic comedy) - 2014

showtimewomen.us.title: No Strings Attached
showtimewomen.us.description: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first? (Romantic comedy) - 2011

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
shoxbetwest.us.description: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. (Thriller, Drama) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Fighting Temptations
shoxbetwest.us.description: Advertising executive Darrin Hill (Cuba Gooding Jr.) loses his job and his girlfriend after his many lies about his background and education are discovered. Soon after, he returns to his small Georgia hometown to collect an inheritance from his Aunt Sally (Ann Nesby). To receive it, he must lead the church choir to victory in a gospel competition. With the help of childhood friend Lilly (Beyoncé Knowles), now a beautiful singer, Darrin gets the choir ready to perform. (Comedy) - 2003

shoxbetwest.us.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years. (Documentary, Music) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Dreamgirls
shoxbetwest.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Norbit
shoxbetwest.us.description: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

shoxbetwest.us.title: 48 HRS.
shoxbetwest.us.description: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom. (Action, Comedy, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1983

shoxbetwest.us.title: Another 48 Hrs.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Equalizer 2

shoxbetwest.us.title: Burn Mother...ker, Burn!

Hays Hodges (Tommy Lee Jones), a comrade-in-arms who owes his life to Childers. (Drama) - 2000

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Rugrats Go Wild
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Ever since her parents left her as a baby, little Annie has led a hard-knock life with her mean foster-mother, Miss Hannigan. However, that all changes when hard-nosed billionaire and mayor candidate Will Stacks takes her in on the recommendation of his advisers. Stacks believes that he's Annie's guardian angel, but the plucky youngster's confidence and sunny outlook may mean that Annie will save Will instead.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wonder Park
skycinemafamily.uk.description: June is a wildly imaginative girl who finds herself in Wonderland -- an amusement park she created in her mind. With the park falling into disarray, she soon teams up with a group of lovable animals to try and save Wonderland before its lost forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
skycinemafamily.uk.description: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets more than he bargained for. A mix-up with the farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead Shaun and the flock to the big city, and it's up to Shaun to return everyone home safely.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Super-Charlie

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Chicken Run

When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Trolls

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man

skycinemafamily.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

themoviechannel.us.title: An Unfinished Life
themoviechannel.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Shall We Dance?
themoviechannel.us.description: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Wakefield
themoviechannel.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. (Drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Surviving Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: A wealthy executive, Drew Latham has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents, Tom Valco and his wife, Christine, a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents. Soon Drew tests the couple's patience, and, when their daughter, Alicia, arrives, things get increasingly tense. (Holiday, Dark comedy, Romantic comedy) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him. (Comedy) - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane!
themoviechannel.us.description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew. - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: The Comeback Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream
themoviechannel.us.description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity. - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Super
themoviechannel.us.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth. - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: The Experts
themoviechannel.us.description: The KGB shanghais a hip New Yorker and his sidekick to teach square spies how to act like Americans for a secret mission. - 1989

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
themoviechannel.us.description: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact. - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: The Terminal
themoviechannel.us.description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport. - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Ghosts
themoviechannel.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Norbit
themoviechannel.us.description: Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town. - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Election
themoviechannel.us.description: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos. - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: Peep World
themoviechannel.us.description: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday. - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Outside Providence
themoviechannel.us.description: In this coming-of-age comedy, Tim Dunphy (Shawn Hatosy) is leading a go-nowhere existence, spending his days smoking pot and hanging out with his best friend, Drugs Delaney (Jon Abrahams). But Tim's lazy days of getting high are jettisoned after a brush with the law convinces his blue-collar dad (Alec Baldwin) to send him to a Connecticut prep school. The one saving grace of the new school is Jane (Amy Smart), a fellow student Tim falls for immediately. (Comedy drama) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
themoviechannel.us.description: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. (Comedy drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. (Comedy drama) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Love & Basketball
themoviechannel.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (Romance, Drama) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: She's All That
themoviechannel.us.description: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: Proof
themoviechannel.us.description: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: View From the Top
themoviechannel.us.description: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. (Comedy, Romance, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Mr. Holmes
themoviechannel.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. (Mystery, Drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Haunter
themoviechannel.us.description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: The Dutchman
themoviechannel.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Four Girls in White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Norma (Florence Rice), Mary (Mary Howard), Pat (Ann Rutherford) and Gertie (Una Merkel) are four nursing students hoping that their long education and investment will lead to a well-paying, stable job. When Bob Maitland (Kent Taylor), the son of their hospital's founder, is checked in, Norma falls for his good looks and his fabulous wealth. When she neglects her other patients to dote on Bob, however, her position in the hospital is put in jeopardy. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pride and Prejudice
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early 19th century in the English village of Meryton, the arrival of wealthy bachelors, most notably Mr. Darcy (Laurence Olivier), stirs up the families with single daughters. Among those is the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters, including the spirited Elizabeth (Greer Garson) and her pretty older sister, Jane (Maureen O'Sullivan). As Mrs. Bennet (Mary Boland) aggressively tries to pair off her girls, Elizabeth crosses swords with the imperious Darcy. (Romantic comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whistling in the Dark
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wally Benton (Red Skelton) isn't a detective, but he plays one on the radio. The confusion between Benton and his crime-solving persona results in a rather perilous situation when cult leader Joseph Jones (Conrad Veidt), greedy for the inheritance of one of his flock, blackmails Benton to craft the perfect murder. Under the watchful eye of Jones' burly thug, Sylvester (Rags Ragland), the actor has to hatch a flawless plot -- or improvise his way out of his predicament. He has until 11 o'clock. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whistling in Brooklyn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A murderer, dubbed the Constant Reader for sending notes to the police with exact locations and descriptions of victims, eludes Inspector Holcomb (Henry O'Neill). On a radio program called The Fox, hosted by Wally Benton (Red Skelton), Holcomb hears Wally describe a letter that sounds similar to those from the Constant Reader. Wally, who is about to marry co-star Carol Lambert (Ann Rutherford), is then pursued by the police and determined cub reporter Jean Pringle (Jean Rogers). (Comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Ghost Comes Home
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A missing man (Frank Morgan) returns and learns his wife (Billie Burke) collected on his life insurance. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Keeping Company
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A real-estate broker (Frank Morgan) and his wife advise the eldest (Ann Rutherford) of their three daughters about marriage. (Romantic comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sorry, Wrong Number
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Due to a telephone glitch, Leona Stevenson (Barbara Stanwyck), a controlling heiress confined to a wheelchair, overhears a conversation about a plan to kill a woman. Unable to leave her home or reach her husband (Burt Lancaster), and written off by the police, Leona struggles to uncover the truth through a series of phone calls that only lead her deeper into a mystery, which may involve her college rival, Sally (Ann Richards), and a scheme to sell pharmaceuticals on the black market. (Thriller) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Criss Cross
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An armored-car guard (Burt Lancaster) must join a robbery after being caught with his ex-wife (Yvonne De Carlo) by her gangster husband (Dan Duryea). (Crime drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Kiss the Blood Off My Hands
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A blackmailer (Robert Newton) hounds a World War II veteran (Burt Lancaster) hiding from the police with a nurse (Joan Fontaine) in London. (Crime drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Brute Force
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Released from solitary confinement, prisoner Joe Collins (Burt Lancaster) learns that his supportive wife, Ruth (Ann Blyth), is refusing surgery to treat her potentially deadly cancer, unless Joe can be by her side after the operation. But while Joe is plotting his escape with fellow prisoner Gallagher (Charles Bickford), a violent incident in the prison machine shop causes the entire prison to go into lockdown mode, overseen by the mean-spirited guard Captain Munsey (Hume Cronyn). (Thriller) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 40 Takes Willy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A documentary about acclaimed film director William Wyler. (Special, Documentary) - 2025-09-11

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blonde Crazy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A hotel bellhop (James Cagney) and his girlfriend (Joan Blondell) work con games, then are conned by a con man (Louis Calhern) themselves. (Crime drama) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Colleen
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A millionaire's nephew (Dick Powell) saves him from a gold digger and falls for a woman (Ruby Keeler) in a dress shop. (Musical comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Public Enemy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two young Chicago hoodlums, Tom Powers (James Cagney) and Matt Doyle (Eddie Woods), rise up from their poverty-stricken slum life to become petty thieves, bootleggers and cold-blooded killers. But with street notoriety and newfound wealth, the duo feels the heat from the cops and rival gangsters both. Despite his ruthless criminal reputation, Tom tries to remain connected to his family, however, gang warfare and the need for revenge eventually pull him away. (Crime drama) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this classic screen adaptation of Shakespeare's fantastical play, the royal wedding plans of Theseus, the duke of Athens (Ian Hunter) and Hippolyta overlap with the antics of forest fairies, led by Oberon and Titania, and a ragtag troupe of actors. Meanwhile, young lovers, including Lysander (Dick Powell) and Hermia (Olivia de Havilland), deceive each other in amusing ways, and magic adds a mischievous element to this enchanted romantic comedy. (Comedy) - 1935

actionmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
actionmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

actionmax.us.title: The Hitcher
actionmax.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
actionmax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

actionmax.us.title: Scanners
actionmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

actionmax.us.title: It
actionmax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

actionmax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
actionmax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Blair Witch

moremax.us.title: Hitchcock
moremax.us.description: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless. Still, the production strains the couple's marriage. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Predator
moremax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
moremax.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
moremax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Girls Trip
moremax.us.description: Four best friends travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. - 2017

moremax.us.title: Mid90s
moremax.us.description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Enemy
moremax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. - 2013

moremax.us.title: My Dead Dad
moremax.us.description: Young burnout Lucas is notified that his estranged father has passed away and has left him an apartment complex in Los Angeles. Lucas meets the eclectic tenants, and soon discovers his father was a different man than the one he knew. - 2021

moremax.us.title: Isle of Dogs
moremax.us.description: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
moremax.us.description: Trapped in digital space by a rogue AI, superstar LeBron James teams up with Bugs Bunny and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. - 2021

moremax.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
moremax.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. - 2021

moremax.us.title: Masterminds
moremax.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. - 2016

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: Two old-school, unemployed salesmen internships at Google, then must compete with younger, smarter candidates for prime positions. - 2013

moremax.us.title: Night on Earth
moremax.us.description: Five brief encounters occur in five taxis on the same night in Los Angeles, New York, Rome, Paris and Helsinki. - 1992

moremax.us.title: Papillon
moremax.us.description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an alliance with counterfeiter Louis Dega to finance his escape. - 2017

moremax.us.title: Ocean's 11
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
moremax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
moremax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Opus
moremax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Time Bandits
moremax.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
moremax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

moremax.us.title: The Man
moremax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Foods That Makes You Manly After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Eating On The Edge Of Nowhere Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on Earth.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E83 Bang For Your Buck Prepare to taste the savings as Adam, musician Sarah McLeod and chef Grant King give you bang for your buck!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lund, Sweden In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year-old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E21 My Goats & Ricotta Lidia grew up around goats, and their delicious milk which were used to make ricotta. She makes spinach ricotta dumplings, an open cookie cannoli, and then ricotta meatloaf with tomato sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Australia Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Kruger Safari Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Nice Our journey heads to Nice the vibrant capital of the French Riviera. For this special day, Luana has designed an itinerary full of surprises, where tradition meets creativity.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E3 Greater Copenhagen: Roof Gardens & Design Castles Copenhagen and Skane are hot food destinations. Tareq visits Ostergro, Denmark's first 'rooftop farm' in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district of Hyllie, Malmo and Hackeberga Castle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Denise Andrews Macale: Bush Turkey Stew & Chilli Fresh Water Mussels In White Wine Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Cooking With Grapes Raise a toast to the glorious grape as Simon and Maggie celebrate with the fruit of the vine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E26 Episode 26 Laura makes her delicious Spinach and Feta Rolls in the heart of the Prahran Market. In the Yarra Valley, Charlie Carrington cooks Chicken Enchiladas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E26 Pesto 2.0 Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a Pesto alla Trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Clontarf Clontarf Reserve is the perfect spot for a BBQ, and Hayden turns things up a notch with recipes featuring beef steaks, lamb cutlets and a pork loin rack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E4 Wendell Pierce Award-winning actor and producer Wendell Pierce is joining Ina for cooking and conversation at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E21 Episode 21 Laura starts the show in the historic Prahran Market making a simple and heart-warming Potato and Leek Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Featuring Matt Keenan, Gary brings together fresh, lively flavours in a menu of poke bowl with salmon, cucumber salad, and a Greek style fetta and greens pie served with Yemeni sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E83 Bang For Your Buck Prepare to taste the savings as Adam, musician Sarah McLeod and chef Grant King give you bang for your buck!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Mashup Recipes Get the best of both worlds when Mary mashes ideas together to get wacky dishes like Caesar salad roast chicken and taco meatball skillet.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E22 Foraging Adventures As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Now she makes chestnut mushroom ragu, asparagus gratin with fried egg, and clam soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Stilton Stilton has been known as the King of English cheeses for more than two centuries, and unlike its traditional cousins, it has never been copied elsewhere.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Eating Johannesburg Johannesburg- the gateway city to exploring South Africa. In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Portofino In Portofino, glamour meets simplicity. Against this picture-perfect backdrop, Luana sets out to meet the people who bring this legendary village to life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Bornholm, Denmark Tareq takes the ferry out to Bornholm, a Danish island that has seen its share of invaders and reluctantly took part in WW2.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Alex Rogers: Crumbed Barra Fillets With Salad, Steamed Barra With Ginger And Soy, Curry Barra Soup This episode is a salute to the fighting freshwater and saltwater barramundi. Alex Rogers whips up a simple dish with one of his favourite fish.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Bbq's Maggie and Simon celebrate the BBQ and show viewers how to get the most from it - be it for starters, main courses and even desserts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E27 Episode 27 Dietitian Simone Austin joins Laura in the market to make a dish that not only tastes great but is also good for your gut health: Braised Greens and Spelt Pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E27 Green Gazpacho And Giant Grilled Shrimp Rachael loves gazpacho, a cold soup made from raw vegetables that is perfect for warm Italian summers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Dee Why Beach Hayden grew up surfing the break at Dee Why Beach, and Hayden finishes up his BBQ Special with recipes featuring a side of salmon, pork belly and a whole butterflied chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Food Is Sewa Shiva’s profession of hospitality interweaves with her own mother’s commitment to the Indian concept of Sewa (being of service to others or the act of giving).

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E52 Episode 52 We've all had bacon and eggs at some point, but have you had them baked all together in a pan?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Family Dineasties

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E6 The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E2 The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E3 The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E4 The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E5 The Pirate Planet: Part 1 In search of the second segment of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Calufrax. But they find that a completely different planet has taken its place.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E6 The Pirate Planet: Part 2 Still in search of the missing planet, Calufrax, the Doctor and Romana encounter the telepathic Mentiads and Zanak’s ruler, the half man, half robot Captain.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E7 The Pirate Planet: Part 3 The Doctor has discovered the sinister truth about Zanak and solved the mystery of the missing planet. On the Bridge, the Doctor meets the real ruler of Zanak.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E8 The Pirate Planet: Part 4 The Doctor and Romana join forces with the Mentiads to prevent the Captain and Xanxia from using Zanak to consume the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E9 The Stones of Blood: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana track the third segment of the Key to Time to the vicinity of an ancient stone circle on Earth. But sinister forces are at work and the stones hide a secret.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E10 The Stones of Blood: Part 2 The leaders of a druidic cult have been killed and it seems that the stones from the stone circle are alive and have a taste for human blood.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E11 The Stones of Blood: Part 3 As the blood hungry Ogri close in, the Doctor launches a desperate attempt to rescue Romana from hyperspace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E12 The Stones of Blood: Part 4 The Doctor releases two alien justice machines from imprisonment who sentenc him to death. Meanwhile Romana urgently searches for clues that will reveal Vivien Fay’s true identity.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E13 The Androids of Tara: Part 1 Arriving on Tara, Romana locates the fourth segment of the Key to Time with ease, but is captured by the scheming Count Grendel who wants the throne of Tara for himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E14 The Androids of Tara: Part 2 Grendel kidnaps Prince Reynart and seems set to be chosen as Tara’s monarch when Reynart fails to arrive at his coronation. But the Doctor has a plan to scupper the Count’s scheme.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E15 The Androids of Tara: Part 3 While Romana makes her escape from the castle, the Doctor is lured to a meeting with an android duplicate of her that is programmed to kill him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E17 The Power of Kroll: Part 1 Tracing the fifth segment of the Key to Time to the third moon of Delta Magna, the Doctor and Romana are soon caught up in the conflict between humans and the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E18 The Power of Kroll: Part 2 The Doctor arrives in time to save Romana from being sacrificed to the bogus god, Kroll. But it’s not long before the very real Kroll makes its terrifying appearance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E19 The Power of Kroll: Part 3 With the giant, squid-like Kroll awake and angry, the Swampies are eager to appease their god by using the Doctor and Romana as sacrificial victims.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E20 The Power of Kroll: Part 4 With Kroll on the rampage, the Doctor and Romana are appalled to discover that Thawn intends to fire a rocket at the creature which will also kill the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E1 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on the old Dalek homeworld of Skaro where the Doctor and the newly regenerated Romana discover that someone is digging deep beneath the planet’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E2 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 2 Romana is captured and interrogated by the Daleks whilst the Doctor meets the Movellans who are equally interested in discovering exactly what the Daleks are searching for.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E3 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 3 Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor before the Daleks can reach him. But the Daleks will stop at nothing to recover their creator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E5 City of Death: Part 1 While on holiday in Paris, the Doctor and Romana experience a time distortion. At the Louvre, someone is taking an unusual amount of interest in the Mona Lisa.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E6 City of Death: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana become the reluctant guests of Scarlioni who is planning to steal the Mona Lisa despite having six Mona Lisas hidden in his cellar – all of them genuine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E7 City of Death: Part 3 Count Scarlioni is revealed to really be Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth and is funding the construction of a time machine – but for what purpose?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E8 City of Death: Part 4 Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction. But the Doctor can’t allow him to succeed as it would mean the destruction of all life on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E9 The Creature from the Pit: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris. The planet is ruled by the ruthless Lady Adrasta who takes the Doctor prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E10 The Creature from the Pit: Part 2 The Doctor has escaped Adrasta’s wrath by jumping down the pit into the last remaining metal mine on Chloris. But the pit is also the home of a monstrous creature.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E11 The Creature from the Pit: Part 3 In the pit, the Doctor establishes contact with the creature and begins to suspect that all is not as it seems.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E12 The Creature from the Pit: Part 4 With Erato now able to communicate, the truth of Adrasta’s scheming is revealed but a terrible retribution has already been put in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E13 Nightmare of Eden: Part 1 A terrible hyperspace accident results in two starships becoming locked together. The Doctor arrives and discovers that the incident may have also released a deadly menace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E14 Nightmare of Eden: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana are horrified to discover that Tryst has been storing real lifeforms in his CET machine and that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E15 Nightmare of Eden: Part 3 The terrifying Mandrels have escaped from Eden and are attacking everyone aboard the Empress. The Doctor and Romana, accused of being smugglers, are pursued by customs officers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E16 Nightmare of Eden: Part 4 The Doctor solves the mystery of the drug smuggling racket and the culprits are revealed. But unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E17 The Horns of Nimon: Part 1 With the TARDIS disabled in order to undergo repairs, the Doctor is powerless when Romana is kidnapped by a battleship which is on its way to Skonnos and the formidable Nimon.
