ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Totally Awesome Beach Day Ultron crashes beach day to build his HQ, and the Iron Friends must stop him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 The Mecha T-rex Timmy can't wait to trick or treat as a Mecha T-Rex, but needs the Mechas' help when he can't reach the arms of his costume.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S24 E14 Yong Bao and the Tiger Yong Bao tells Thomas the story of how he came to have a magnificent tiger emblem on his tender.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E12 Grandpa Pig's Greenhouse Grandpa Pig and Grandpa Dog are showing and sharing their lovely, tomato filled greenhouses to Peppa and George.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E29 Sailing Boat Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George sailing, but they keep getting stuck in the mud!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E24 Rainy Day Kiri sings a sad song which makes everyone cry - even herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Tummy Ache When Ginger gets a nasty tummy ache, the Pea-Rexes have to find a special soothing herb which unfortunately is in the middle of Bananaraptor island!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Cows The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a Big Farm, to find cows. They travel to Lucy Big's Farm, where she shows them all the animals.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Red Lunch Special When her parents are too busy to have lunch, Flower takes matters into her own hands and creates a stunning red-themed feast just for them!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E6 Big Dig Sparks learns to share his upset feelings.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E53 Deep Freeze The biggest party of the year could be cancelled after Escarlata La Pirata freezes the high seas!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Robot The Hero Robot wants to be a \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 Mimic Octopus The Octonauts recruit a shape-shifting mimic octopus to help them recover an important vial of medicinal algae from a moray eel's lair.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 The Rocking Horse Badge Duggee introduces the squirrels to Bucky, his old rocking horse. Saddle up, squirrels!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E13 Little Trev's Turtle Big Trev tells Pounce and Gemma a tale from his childhood as they wait for his elderly turtle friend, Salty, to arrive.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E13 Dily's Sizzlin' Sauce When Dilys takes her eye off the stove for a split second, the Cut Price Store catches on fire, trapping Norman upstairs!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Nikhil and Jay and the Train to Chennai When a power cut interrupts their call, the boys feel sad they are not in Chennai with Ammamma and Thatha. They pretend to take a train all the way there to see them!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E76 Sign of the Times Super-speedy Eighteen discovers a faster way to add a number together lots of times.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monster Makes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Underwater Adventure Is there an alien in the attic or, is it just another fabulous transformation? A paper bowl becomes a sea turtle, boxes become boats and a bottle becomes a manta ray.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey Puppets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Make Your Own Floppy Straight from Bingo's dream in the iconic Sleepytime episode, it's Floppy! In this magical crafting adventure, our puppet makers recreate Bingo's beloved bunny.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E23 Pants and the Rainbow Rope Everyone in Kibble Corners is looking for Popcorn's lost toy, but Pants keeps getting distracted by a colourful new rope in the park.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Humpty's Big Book of Nursery Rhymes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S375 E3 Food and Garden Rhymes Nursery Rhymes about food? Yum! And gardens? Great! Special guest Miranda joins Kaeng and Leah to host a Gardening Show where we meet Peter Piper, Jack and Jill and Little Miss Muffet. And we all enjoy a lovely cup of tea!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E13 Episode 13 Did someone say holiday? John is getting ready for his big holiday to the Philippines! Come along and help him pack, snorkel, and learn all about the lovely fish in the water!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E15 Supermarkets Fizzy and Suds explore a supermarket! They follow deliveries, restocking, and cool rooms, then zip through aisles on a trolley ride and bleep through the busy checkout!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: L'il Stompers ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 L'il Bit Of Advice Billy is having trouble learning to ride a new skateboard she got from her parents. Her friends all have different ideas about the best way for her to learn, which causes her more trouble than her own practicing.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E13 The Last Scoreberry Ginger and the Peas climb the Snowy Mountains to find the last Scoreberries of the season.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E23 Rainbow Connection Why are flowers all different colours? How do different pollinators see colour? The gardeners create beautiful flower bouquets for bees, butterflies and birds.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Wild Workouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Rainforest Andy is off on a rainforest adventure and he wants you to come along! He treks into deep rainforest in search of an orangutan. Along the way he swings through the trees with some spider monkeys and dances with manakin birds.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E53 The Giddy-Up Games The crew agree to play a series of cowboy-themed games against the villainous Barbarito in an attempt to win a treasure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E47 Critter Tower Takedown When Cat Burglar steals the Critter Tower, the SuperKitties and their new wildcat friend have to save it, so everyone can play.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 The Duck Badge When a duckling mistakes Norrie for its mother, however, the Squirrels head inside - only to discover that all the ducklings follow their new 'mum' inside too!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E47 Cricket During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E43 The Apple Tree Peppa and family enjoy their garden apple tree all year round, through Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E44 The Big Hill Peppa and her family are going for a walk in the countryside and end up climbing a big hill. When they get to the top there is a wonderful view.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E27 Listen Dalvanius' giant ears help him hear the music of nature.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Hot and Cold Volcanic smoke blocks the three Proximan suns and cause Big Lizard to become worryingly cold. Cosima's on the case and comes up with a super-hot solution!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 The Octonauts And The Vampire Squid Peso must gather all his courage when he travels deep down to the very bottom of the ocean, the Midnight Zone, and encounters the mysterious Vampire Squid!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E24 The Bestest Beach The cadets pull out all the stops to impress a beach inspector and win the prestigious Bestest Beach Award, all in honour of their dedicated lifeguard heroes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E8 Monster-Preciation Night The Super Monsters' chaotic restaurant takeover turns into a heartfelt lesson in teamwork and gratitude.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E75 Green Goblin's Dino Disaster Spidey and Reptil team up against Green Goblin's new Dino Mech.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E48 Ghostbasket Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum. But Janet and Rita don't want to move out!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Guardian of the Tooth When Flower loses her first tooth, she enlists Flour the cat to help keep it safe and make sure the tooth fairy can find it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E28 Miss Jolly's Riding Club Ben, Holly and their friends go on a snail trek with Miss Jolly. The trek goes well until the snails head straight toward the Elf Farm and Mr Elf's cabbages.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Detective Pancake Investigates Pancake's golden algae goes missing, leaving all the Piri friends under suspicion.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E10 Walkie-Talkie The veggies are playing walkie talkie hide and seek and Carrot is giving clues to the others as to where she is hiding.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Batwheels
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E11 The Ulti-Bat Rises, Part 1 When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur. Part 1.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 Asparagus Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table - they're not animals. But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyone's got a wild side.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E6 The Smelly Farmer The Farmer's personal hygiene leaves much to be desired. Shaun, Bitzer and the Flock decide action is needed - and set about giving the Farmer a full service wash.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ninjago ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E9 Curseworld Part: 1 When Moro uses the Realm Crystal to open a portal to the Cursed Realm, ghosts take over the town – but the Ninja, in disguise, manage to get Lloyd to the centre of the town, and Lloyd steals the crystal.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E7 A Tougher Nut and a Note on File Sheldon's search for a comic book leads him to a breakthrough. Also, Georgie and Mandy have an uncomfortable first encounter with her parents, Jim and Audrey.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BtN Newsbreak ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E196 Episode 196 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E8 Legalese and a Whole Hoo-Ha Sheldon's database invention puts him at odds with the university. Also, the church takes issue with Meemaw's video store.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Animal Park ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S19 E11 Visitors are confusing the park's wallabies with the much larger kangaroo, so one is on its way to the park, but the keepers are nervous, just how big will this kangaroo be?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Recipe of the Year
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 The competition continues as our 10 home cooks dive into the ultimate source of comfort - the treasured recipes passed down through generations.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 To Kill The King When Gwen suffers tragedy at Uther's hand, Morgana becomes hell-bent on revenge.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E22 This Is Us Jessica sets her sights on a private school for Evan and explores the idea of moving to an upscale neighbourhood. Meanwhile, Louis gets a chance to expand Cattleman's Ranch with his new silent partner, singer Michael Bolton.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E4 Blonde Ambition and the Concept of Zero Sheldon makes a terrifying mathematical discovery while tutoring Billy. Also, Mary is jealous of Missy's relationship with Mandy and Meemaw.

Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kdsm.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
kdsm.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

kptv.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
kptv.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Hombre pequeño abusado; Doble traición

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Barrigas en discordia; La premonición
nbcuniverso.us.description: Tres mujeres embarazadas del mismo hombre reclaman una casa familiar, alegan que no tienen a dónde ir. En otro caso, una niña goza del don de la premonición, alguien dice lo que va a pasar. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Enséñame humildad
nbcuniverso.us.description: Marina vive en la calle y es víctima de explotación. Ella sueña con estudiar y mejorar su vida, pero su situación no se lo permite. Luego de que Leopoldo la atropella con su auto, la vida cambia para ella. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Lazos recuperados

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Jimena y Azul, lazos de sangre
nbcuniverso.us.description: Aunque son madre e hija y se llevan como amigas, ninguna imagina que un hombre sembraría la discordia entre ellas cuando Jimena se deja llevar por la pasión y Azul se convierte en la víctima. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Un día para vivir - Ella

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wofl.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wofl.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

wxix.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
wxix.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

discoverywest.us.title: Lone Star Law
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E12 Wild Riders Wardens Matt Kiel and Michael Serbanic race to confront reckless jet skiers who are wreaking havoc at a boat ramp; a rogue ATV rider tries to lie his way out of a trespassing charge; a crabber turns hostile when caught without a fishing license.

discoverywest.us.title: Lone Star Law
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E06 Lake Showdown A drunken man wreaks havoc on Sam Rayburn Lake; Wardens Randy Sovall and Sean Reneau deal with the aftermath; Warden Mike Boone tracks down the culprits responsible for an illegal dumpsite; a gator is residing in a family's pond.

discoverywest.us.title: Lone Star Law
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E05 Sunk in Seconds On Sam Rayburn Lake, Game Wardens Morgan Inman and Austin Cryer discover that a brave citizen rescued passengers from a swamped boat; doves are found dead from a suspected poisoning; alligators are found on school property.

discoverywest.us.title: Lone Star Law
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E04 Deadly Spill Game Warden Randolph McGee assesses a major gasoline spill in the local water system then tracks down a trash dumping culprit; young jet skiers are confronted, and game warden Mike Boone helps relocate an alligator.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E03 Avalanche Country Competing companies team up to recover a fully loaded cement truck leaking natural gas; Big Jon heads into avalanche country to rescue a stuck semi carrying hazardous goods; during a sudden blizzard, a crash in Salt Lake City leaves a semi in pieces.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E01 Living Life on the Edge A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E02 The Tunnel of Chaos The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; Mountain Recovery and Stauffer's Towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E04 Disaster in Denver Mountain Recovery faces a tight deadline to recover a semi in a Denver water reservoir; high winds roll over a hauler carrying groceries through Wyoming.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border

"Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. 5starmax.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (Musical comedy) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: The Daytrippers
5starmax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (Comedy drama) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe. - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. - 2007

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society. - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: Agent Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) comes to Twin Peaks, Wash., following two unresolved murders and the disappearance of two fellow agents. - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Volunteers
5starmax.us.description: An Ivy Leaguer (Tom Hanks) avoids his bookie by going with the Peace Corps to build a bridge in 1962 Thailand. - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Hoot
5starmax.us.description: After moving from Montana, a youth and his new friends in Florida take on corrupt politicians and greedy developers in a fight to protect endangered owls. - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
5starmax.us.description: With the sitter dead, a Los Angeles teen (Christina Applegate) lands a job in the fashion industry to feed her siblings. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Heaven Help Us
5starmax.us.description: In the 1960s, a group of teen pranksters finds it difficult to toe the line in a strictly disciplined Catholic school. - 1985

5starmax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
5starmax.us.description: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek. - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Take the Lead
5starmax.us.description: Renowned ballroom dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a job at a New York City public school and helps his students meld hip-hop and classical styles to create a dance form. - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
5starmax.us.description: In a prison cell somewhere in Latin America, two very different men warily confront each other. Molina (William Hurt) is first seen wrapping his head in a towel, in the shape of a turban, while Valentin (Raul Julia), bearded and classically macho in appearance, watches with a mixture of fascination and revulsion. During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other. (Drama) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Robin Hood
5starmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
5starmax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: It
5starmax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

5starmax.us.title: The Hitcher
5starmax.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

backstage.us.title: Awake
backstage.us.description: While undergoing surgery, a young man (Hayden Christensen) experiences intraoperative awareness. He becomes fully alert -- but paralyzed -- and therefore cannot tell his doctors that he is not sedated and is enduring the whole process. Meanwhile, his wife (Jessica Alba) wrestles with demons of her own while her husband suffers through his ordeal. (Thriller) - 2007

backstage.us.title: Beat Street
backstage.us.description: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams. (Musical, Drama) - 1984

backstage.us.title: Fled
backstage.us.description: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them. (Action) - 1996

backstage.us.title: Foxy Brown
backstage.us.description: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother. (Crime drama) - 1974

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge. (Drama) - 1997

bbcearth.us.title: Hidden India
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Lands of Change Exploring the secrets behind India's abundance of wildlife and nature, with such a wide landscape and many living conditions.

bbcearth.us.title: Hidden India
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Land of Mountains India fosters its own array of unique wildlife, surrounded by Western Ghats, hills covered in lush forests, tea gardens and the mighty Himalayas.

bbcearth.us.title: Hidden India
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Land of Rivers Explores the mighty Ganges river, which provides a home for many, and the beaches that are a haven for thousands of turtles.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Battle to Save the Tiger Investigating India's growing problem with tiger poaching; tiger scientist turned whistleblower, Raghu uncovers the scale of the problem.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Nature's Biggest Beasts How the world's biggest beasts overcome the challenges of their size.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Dragon's Bite Dr. Bryan Fry discovers there's a lot more to the Komodo dragon than meets the eye - from hidden venom glands to its secret origins.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Highgrove: A Prince's Legacy Charting a year in the running of Highgrove, home to the Prince of Wales, who takes an active part in the management of the organic garden and estate.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Super Fast Falcon The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal on Earth; but what does it take to be a high-speed record breaker?

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Lobo: The Wolf That Changed America See how a man's mission to kill a wolf had a lasting impact on wilderness preservation.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Attenborough's Ark David Attenborough chooses ten animals that he would most like to save from extinction.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Five Big Cats and a Camera The lives of cheetahs, leopards, servals, caracals and lions.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Echo of the Elephants: The Next Generation The elephant calf Ely is followed for four years through Kenya's Amboseli National Park.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Bowerbirds: The Art of Seduction David Attenborough travels to the remote highlands of New Guinea and the rainforests of Australia to explore the world of the bowerbird, a creature which flaunts its charms, steals for its own purposes and indulges in spiteful acts.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Bat Man of Mexico Featuring the story of Rodrigo Medellin, who has dedicated his life to saving bats.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Weasels: Feisty and Fearless Delve into the adventures of first-time stoat mum Bandita as she raises her kits in a unique weasel wonderland, with over 50 hidden cameras; cameras capture a half-ounce orphaned least weasel called Twiz embarking on her journey back to the wild.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Lions: Pride in Peril A film following the Tokitok pride of lions in Tanzania's breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Attenborough's Wonder of Eggs David Attenborough shares his passion for birds' eggs, from their ability to nurture new life, to their strength to withstand the weight of an incubating parent and their potential to allow a chick to break free.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Meet the Bears Showcases how bears across the world have overcome the challenges of life, from finding food and raising cubs, to confronting rivals and habitat loss, all thanks to brains, brawn and amazing adaptability.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World: In the Eye of the Wind
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 From the windswept tundra of Arctic Russia to the lava-spewing volcanoes of Hawaii, a great migration is underway.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Lost Elephants of Timbuktu In the heart of the Sahara Desert, a herd of elephants emerges from behind a wind-swept sand dune.

bbcearth.us.title: Craft in America
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Memory History of the craft movement; some of the best craft artists in America.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Snow Leopard: Beyond the Myth Nisar Malik spends two years documenting the daily life of the snow leopard, the most elusive of all cats.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Jaguars: Brazil's Super Cats South America's supreme predator, jaguars are also one of the most elusive animals on the planet; a pioneering team in Brazil tracks individual wild jaguars to gain amazing insight into their lives.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Himalayas A documentary looking at the variety of wild animals inhabiting the Himalayas.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Badgers: Secrets of the Sett While badgers are easily recognized, remarkably few people have ever seen one alive; it's a creature blamed for destruction and disease, but surprisingly little is known about the sett society.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Echo Ely and Friends - Africa's Forgotten Elephants This film goes beyond events at the Amboseli National Park, in search of elephants living in Africa's vast landscape.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Florida: America's Animal Paradise Florida is famous for its beaches, blue water and year-round sun, but it also has a surprising wild side; it is home to pine forests, coral reefs and the famous Everglades wetland, the largest subtropical wilderness in the U.S.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Last Grizzly of Paradise Valley Wildlife filmmaker Jeff Turner finds the Cascade Mountains under threat, especially its last grizzly bears.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Meerkats: Secrets of an Animal Superstar David Attenborough tells the story behind the world's most famous meerkat family.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Cast Adrift Stories of New Zealand's creatures and people, who rise to the challenges of their homeland.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Wild Extremes The story of New Zealand's wildest places and its most resilient pioneers.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 New Arrivals The story of New Zealand's wildlife and its changing fortunes since the arrival of humans.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 A Dangerous World Capuchin, giant otter and coatis babies take their first steps during a brief pause between seasonal extremes.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Facing the Flood The giant otters, coatis and capuchin monkeys have to learn how to survive as the river floods.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Enduring the Drought The monkeys, otters, coatis and jaguars battle to survive as drought and fires ravage the country.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Mountain Worlds The Serranías del Burro serves as a vital outpost for Mexico's black bears.

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Forests of the Maya The ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds make their home; it is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Soft and Crisp Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sugar and Spice Nigel shows a classic cinnamon, ginger and plum cake and demonstrates the unexpected such as sticky ribs and a spicy lentil stew with caramelized onions.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Born and Bred Nigel transforms everyday suppers, including a dish of baked mushrooms and chestnuts and a home-grown pud of blackberry and fig pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Cambodia and Vietnam Rick enjoys freshly caught swimmer crabs cooked with green peppercorns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Vietnam and Thailand Rick Stein travels down the Mekong River to Vietnam.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Thailand and Malaysia Rick travels to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Malaysia and Sri Lanka Rick explores the multi-faceted cuisines of Penang; in Sri Lanka, he continues his passion for seafood by visiting a bustling fishing village.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sri Lanka and Bali Rick visits Sri Lanka and discovers a wealth of hot and spicy vegetable curries.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bangladesh Curry is at the top of Rick's list as he ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Making the Most of It Nigel shows ways to cook with an abundance of ingredients.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Unsung Heroes Nigel cooks haddock chowder, crumbed lamb steak with buttered Swede mash and fennel feta linguine.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Do Yourself a Flavour Nigel introduces new flavor combinations that will reinvigorate our weekly shopping; ricotta beef burger, sesame seed salmon with miring and lemon and thyme cake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Simple Treats Nigel cooks seven delicious dishes, including chicken and leek pie, mushroom medley and raspberry and cinnamon meringue.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 One Pan Wonders Nigel demonstrates that sometimes simple cookery is the best; herby artichoke stew, chicken in cider and compost crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Every Last Bit Nigel offers butternut squash soup with chips, rib ragout and cherry chocolate iced rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Try Something Different Nigel shows how versatile ingredients in a weekly shop can be; duck and citrus salad, hot yogurt steak and chocolate beetroot cake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 When Nothing Else Will Do Nigel cooks up slow roast leg of lamb with herb rub and Parmesan mash, almond and lentil stew and tumbler trifle.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

combatwarchannel.us.title: Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 The Reign of Stalin Soviet domination of Eastern European countries will be total and will remain so until the dictator's death in 1953.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Africa Freed
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at the United Nations's conquest of Tunisia, who on land, sea and air, worked as one.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Yom Kippur War - 1973 Arab-Israeli War Yom Kippur, the holiest day on the Jewish calendar; Israeli troops came under surprise attack by Syrian and Egyptian forces, ten times greater than their own.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Kwai - The Death Railway
combatwarchannel.us.description: In 1942, Japan forced over 200,000 Asian civilians and 65,000 Western POWs to build a railway through the Thai-Burmese jungle. After 15 months, 120,000 were dead from exhaustion, hunger, and disease.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in the Pacific
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 The Rise of the Japanese Empire The rise of Japanese power leads to the attack on Pearl Harbor.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E03 Karl Doenitz Karl Doenitz, a ruthless Nazi commander, Hitler called him "The Man with the Iron Heart"; he helped design the Holocaust, responsible for the imprisonment, torture and deaths of millions.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Hitler and Churchill: The Eagle And the Lion
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Winston Churchill, a revered man of the century versus Adolf Hitler, a hated leader in contemporary history.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle of the Bulge
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Tigers on the Loose A combat story of 10th armored division in World War II.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The History of Tanks
combatwarchannel.us.description: Documenting the changing face of tank warfare over the past 100 years, this fascinating documentary is not to be missed by those with an interest in military history and weapon development.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E10 The Long Trial of Tokyo In 1946, Tokyo, 28 top Japanese officials are tried for war crimes by an international tribunal, modeled on Nuremberg; the trial lasts two and a half years; exploring how did the trial impact Japan and why it took so long.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E18 The Year 1944 Roosevelt, Churchill and Stalin congregate at the Teheran Conference in 1943; U.S. troops land and fight on Kwajalein, Eniwetok, Saipan, Guam and other Pacific islands; Russian troops advance to Romania and capture German soldiers.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Air Assault In the early morning hours of 17th of January 1991, coalition air forces unleashed a massive air assault on Iraqi forces.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Bomber: Terror of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 The World at War Examining the mass bombing raids after Battle of Britain across Nazi-occupied Europe and German cities and how the U.S. and Japan successfully bomb naval and land targets throughout the Pacific theater.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E09 Summer On June 22, 1941, Nazi Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, invading the USSR and shattering the non-aggression pact; the Soviets, caught off guard, faced disaster.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Guy Martin's D-Day Landing
combatwarchannel.us.description: To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Guy Martin restores a Dakota plane and parachutes into the Normandy countryside where the operation occurred.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E14 Facing the Music (January - March 1943) The German Sixth Army at Stalingrad faces surrender as their only option; German cities encounter bombing similar to what Britain faced in 1940; the Allied commanders plan a return to France.

combatwarchannel.us.title: My Grandparents' War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Kristin Scott Thomas Kristin Scott Thomas uncovers the story of how her grandfather William saved thousands at Dunkirk while serving as a commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout World War II.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 The Hitler Youth: Nazi Child Army In the 1930s Germany, the Hitler Youth indoctrinated children to become loyal soldiers for Hitler; tracing its rise, from early propaganda to wartime mobilization.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Nazi Death Marches
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at film archives and written journals documenting the final months of World War II, in which 700,000 prisoners were evacuated from concentration camps and traveled throughout Europe, but many were massacred by guards or civilians.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII In 1933, Hitler rose to power and the Nazis seized control; foreign diplomats in Berlin witnessed the regime's rise and Jewish persecution-but their warnings went unheeded.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: True, untold combat stories of everyday citizen soldiers fighting on the front lines of Europe during WWII.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E01 The Battle of Kiev Archive film, computer-generated imagery and innovative reconstructions tell the Red Army's story of their bloody defeat to Nazi Germany in Kiev in 1941.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Late War Fighters of the Luftwaffe
combatwarchannel.us.description: The ME262, known as one of the best aircraft of World War Two and created by German engineers.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 The Battle of the Beaches In June 1944, the Allies landed in Normandy, beginning a momentous struggle against Nazi occupation that would take almost 100 days to break the German resistance in a military operation unrivalled in history.

combatwarchannel.us.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E15 Good Bye Vietnam The story of the last hours of the Fall of Saigon.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 A Wing and a Prayer The USAAF First Motion Picture Unit, witnesses a dangerous mission against the tyranny of Nazi Germany; B-17 and B-24 Bombers of the Eighth Air Force are assaulted by deadly anti-aircraft guns and savaged by Herman Goring's Luftwaffe.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Annihilation - The Destruction of Europe's Jews
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Final Solution Nearly 13,000 French and foreign Jews were arrested in Paris on July 16, 1942.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E04 The Battle of the Caucasus An attack on Soviet oil fields could have led to a victory, but resistance thwarted Hitler's dream.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in Europe
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 America's Unpreparedness Before the attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941, the United States upgrades its military forces.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 The Persian Gulf War - Part 1 Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Jets Over Vietnam
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at the Vietnam War from an air combat perspective, including how the superpowers, the U.S. and the USSR, had the opportunity to put their best technology and weapons systems into the sky to fight it out.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Visions of War: U.S. Marines
combatwarchannel.us.description: Land the Landing Force Visions of War: U.S. Marines

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in the Pacific
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E11 Attack in the Central Pacific: Makin and Tarawa The Marines face overwhelming odds in the central Pacific.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Vietnam War: The Invisible Enemy
combatwarchannel.us.description: The perspective of both sides, including wartime footage from North Vietnamese sources.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 On All Fronts The year 1943 marks the turning point in the war, as the Allies open new fronts; the invasion of Italy, the battle for Stalingrad, and the island-hopping campaigns in the Pacific begin to turn the tide.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Swallows
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Episode 1 Zhenya faces an extremely dangerous task: to destroy the enemy ammunition and fuel station; her best friend is demoted and faces a tribunal.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Beginning
combatwarchannel.us.description: Advance into Poland, Part 1 German assault troops land on the river's edge and advance rapidly through city streets.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The US Battle for Supremacy in the Pacific
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Doolittle Raid Over Tokyo Jimmy Doolittle prepares for the raid over Tokyo; pilots and planes are shown on board the carrier.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Death Train
combatwarchannel.us.description: Revisiting the first massive crime of WWII killing 13,000 people in the city of Iasi, Romania that lays out the early stages of the Shoah.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Big Picture: A Nation Builds Under Fire How the people of the Republic of Vietnam attempted to build a nation amidst the holocaust of war.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Attackers
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E09 Eugenia tells the general that the enemy is concentrating unprecedented forces in the square; the commander orders several fighter pilots to reinforce the general's transport plane and provide him with protection when he returns to headquarters.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Blood Money: Inside the Nazi Economy
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 A World War on Credit After WWI, Germany grapples with poverty and industrial decline; the Nazi party's vision of a path to greatness hinges on total war, and their initial mission is to secure funding.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 The Persian Gulf War - Part 1 Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone WWII: Marines in Combat
combatwarchannel.us.description: The US Marines fight against the Japanese during WWII.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Spies and Intelligence: From the OSS to the CIA
combatwarchannel.us.description: This film explores Soviet political viewpoints and shows ways in which the U.S. countered Soviet propaganda, including the use of the U.S. Information Agency (USIA).

combatwarchannel.us.title: Spies and Intelligence: From the OSS to the CIA
combatwarchannel.us.description: This film explores Soviet political viewpoints and shows ways in which the U.S. countered Soviet propaganda, including the use of the U.S. Information Agency (USIA).

combatwarchannel.us.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East
combatwarchannel.us.description: Long a hotbed of strife and unrest, the Middle East is the epicenter of some of the world's bloodiest and most sustained battles.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Recon - Military CSI
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at how the military uses forensic science to solve crimes and cold cases on the battlefield.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
combatwarchannel.us.description: In-depth analysis of battles fought during the Vietnam War.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Impossible Peace
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at what went wrong in the Treaty of Versailles in 1919 that caused a second World War.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Movie
combatwarchannel.us.description: Movie to be announced.

comet.us.title: Deathsport
comet.us.description: Ranger guides (David Carradine, Claudia Jennings) on horseback wield transparent swords against 30th-century motorcycle gladiators. (Science fiction, Action, Drama, Thriller) - 1978

comet.us.title: Stargate SG-1 - Serpent's Venom
comet.us.description: The team is dispatched to try to disrupt a possible alliance between the lords of two powerful systems. (Science fiction, Adventure) - 2000-09-29

comet.us.title: Stargate SG-1 - Chain Reaction
comet.us.description: Gen. Hammond (Don S. Davis) announces his retirement, shocking everyone at the SGC. With Richard Dean Anderson. (Science fiction, Adventure) - 2001-01-05

comet.us.title: The Librarians - And the Echoes of Memory
comet.us.description: The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-02-07

comet.us.title: The Librarians - And the Crown of King Arthur
comet.us.description: Someone is killing off potential Librarians, and it's up to Flynn Carsen and his new Guardian, Colonel Eve Baird, to save the three that are left. (Drama, Adventure) - 2014-12-07

comet.us.title: Grimm - Tarantella
comet.us.description: Nick and Hank find themselves on the hunt for a deadly heartbreaker leaving behind a web of dead bodies; Nick's growing recognition among the creature world is starting to threaten not only his safety but Juliette's as well. (Drama, Horror, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2012-02-10

comet.us.title: Grimm - Last Grimm Standing
comet.us.description: The investigation into a double homicide leads Nick to discover a fight club in the Wesen community; Nick must draw on his inner strength to defend Monroe when he gets in trouble while helping out. (Drama, Horror, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2012-02-24

comet.us.title: Season of the Witch
comet.us.description: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2011

comet.us.title: Grimm - Three Coins in a Fuchsbau

cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Hosts Bridget Lancaster, Julia Collin Davison and Toni Tipton-Martin offer a practical, no-nonsense and scientific approach to making a wide range of American recipes, from barbecue chicken thighs to Mississippi mud pie to parmesan potatoes. The hosts are joined by test cooks Morgan Bolling, Lawman Johnson, Christie Morrison, Ashley Moore, Bryan Roof and Kelly Song. Episodes include equipment recommendations for the home cook, taste tests and regional recipes such as coastal Georgia paella and mesquite-grilled tacos rasurados. (Cooking) - 2014-08-30

fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

Benson, who believes the safe passage of his men takes precedence over the colonel's medical needs, seizes the truck to transport his platoon's equipment -- a decision that Montana fiercely opposes. As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut, and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. nickelodeonwest.us.description: Poppy and Branch discover that there are six different troll tribes scattered over six different lands. Each tribe is also devoted to six different kinds of music -- funk, country, techno, classical, pop and rock. When rockers Queen Barb and King Thrash set out to destroy the other music, Poppy and Branch embark on a daring mission to unite the trolls and save the diverse melodies from becoming extinct. (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2020

Ted would very much like to win the heart of Audrey (Taylor Swift), the girl of his dreams, but to do this, he must find that which she most desires: a Truffula tree. To get it, Ted delves into the story of the Lorax (Danny DeVito), once the gruff guardian of the forest, and the Once-ler (Ed Helms), who let greed overtake his respect for nature. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2012

retroplex.us.title: Twice Upon a Yesterday
retroplex.us.description: Victor Bukowski cheats on girlfriend Sylvia Weld, who rebounds and gets engaged to Dave Summers. Wishing he could undo his error, Victor happens upon two otherworldly trash collectors, who send him back in time. He uses the opportunity to woo Sylvia again, while making sure that an attractive woman catches Dave's eye. But his attraction to a waitress, Louise, could ruin Victor's plan to right things with Sylvia. (Comedy drama) - 1998

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Bar 20 Justice
retroplex.us.description: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine. (Western, Drama) - 1938

retroplex.us.title: Vengeance Valley
retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Colorado
retroplex.us.description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: In Old Caliente
retroplex.us.description: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
retroplex.us.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
