smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E05 Fixing For A Fight: U.S. Army Mega Repair Base Mike works with the U.S. Army in Germany inside the massive fix facility the MAK, Maintenance Activity Kaiserslautern, as teams repair over one hundred Bradley fighting vehicles, then embeds with troops in a massive two-week-long battle exercise. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Monster Jam At Monster Jam, custom-built monster trucks roll, flip and fly through the air; with the metal-bending beating these trucks endure, teams of specialized mechanics race against the clock to repair these engineering marvels in time for the next event. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E07 US Navy Hovercraft Overhaul Mike joins the Assault Craft Unit 5, the U.S. Navy's team for Landing Craft Air Cushions (LCACs); LCACs carry heavy vehicles and troops onto beaches; Mike helps fly & fix an overhauled LCAC during a U.S. Marines beach assault training mission. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E06 Sealing Nevada's Abandoned Mines Nevada has over 40,000 abandoned mines posing dangers; Mike joins contractors for a week to secure five sites; alongside biologists, they explore and document wildlife; reaching these isolated mines requires barges, helicopters and bulldozers. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? ᴺᵉʷ
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E04 Stratolaunch In the Mojave Desert, crews prepare Roc, the world's largest airplane, for a tandem flight with a 747 by repairing its wing, inspecting landing gear and engines and training chase pilots for the mission. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E05 Reef Rescue Mike in northeastern Australia, goes on and under the water, into labs and onto construction projects working with specialized teams; they tackle the challenge of saving dying coral on the Great Barrier Reef. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E19 New York City: Preservation & Planning Norm meets local refinisher John Thomas for an assessment of the wood finishes in the house and how to properly restore them; some period-appropriate tile combinations for the bathrooms and kitchen; converting the old steam radiators to hot water.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E20 New York City: In With the New Inspecting the new exterior paint job; white oak flooring is laid down in the parlor with two decorative accent strips of cherry; plaster crown moldings are replicated; the progress on a new retaining wall; the brick patio; new replacement windows.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E21 New York City: Making it Their Own Checking the progress in the owner's unit as the new white oak flooring is installed; the showerhead combination that includes a master showerhead, a handheld showerhead and tub filler; the paint color scheme for the first floor; a new privacy fence.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E22 New York City: Restoring and Replacing Installing vintage spiral stairs; the new plaster medallion is installed in the parlor; laying down click-together linoleum floor tiles; Norm Abram sees how the original five panel interior doors are rehabilitated.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E21 Texas Plants; New Window Roger Cook travels to Dallas to help a homeowner plant a garden using native species that are drought-tolerant; Roger uses expanded shale and compost to amend the clay soil; Tom Silva helps a homeowner replace a door with a picture window.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E22 Tile; Weatherstripping Contractor Angelo McRae explains to a homeowner how to lay out the tile, apply the thin-set and set the tile for a bathroom floor; Tom helps a homeowner add weatherstripping to her front door.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E23 Solar PPA; Framing Walls Ross Trethewey travels to San Francisco to learn about new ways to finance the installation of photovoltaic solar panels; Ross installs a new solar power system for a homeowner: Tom helps a homeowner frame the walls for a basement-remodeling project.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E24 Historic Windows; Filter General contractor Tom Silva heads to Alexandria, Virginia to restore the windows in a home built by George Washington; Richard installs a water filter at a kitchen sink.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E25 Generator; Clogged Sewer Host Kevin O'Connor and electrician Scott Caron travel to Annapolis, Md., to install a manual transfer switch for a portable generator; the guys ask What Is It?; Richard heads to Dallas to fix a sewer line that is clogged with tree roots.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E26 Spray Paint; Wood Floor Roger Cook and Kevin refinish several worn-out items using spray paint; Richard Trethewey shows Kevin some new household devices that can be operated hands-free; Tom Silva removes wall-to-wall carpet and installs a pre-finished wood floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E01 Shelves; Washing Machine General contractor Tom Silva helps a couple transform stock shelving into a custom built-in; plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey installs a new washing machine valve that will prevent flooding.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E02 Bluestone Patio; Bikes Landscape contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner install a bluestone patio in an urban backyard; What Is It?; Tom helps a homeowner and her daughter hang their bikes in a small garage; in the loft, Roger demonstrates the single-folding bike rack.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E03 Mantel; Leaky Faucet Tom Silva builds a custom fireplace mantel for a homeowner; Roger shares some tips about garden edging; Richard helps a homeowner repair a leaking kitchen faucet; in the loft, Richard shows the Diamond Seal Technology valve.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E04 Sod; Wireless Thermostat Helping a homeowner lay sod in his backyard; What Is It?; Tom shares a tip about finding measurements without doing math; installing a wireless thermostat to control a heating system; an app that allows the thermostat to be controlled remotely.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E05 Palm Trees; Combo Boiler Roger Cook heads to Miami to help a homeowner plant several varieties of palm trees; Kevin shares information on new light bulbs; Richard replaces an old heating system and hot water heater with a much smaller and more efficient single appliance.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E06 Task Lights; Cable Rail Richard Trethewey tours a scale model of New York City; host Kevin O'Connor works with a local electrician to add task lighting to a dark kitchen in Brooklyn; Tom helps a homeowner in Greenwich Village add a cable railing system to her deck.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S11 E07 Kitchen Sink; Sidelights Richard Trethewey heads to Colorado Springs to install a brand-new kitchen sink and faucet; Tom Silva installs insulated sidelights on a front door.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E17 New Orleans: Return to New Orleans, Post Katrina Helping a New Orleans resident return home; stories of rebuilding and recovery throughout the city; visiting Musicians' Village with founder Harry Connick Jr. to see how he and Branford Marsalis are providing new housing for musicians.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E18 New Orleans: Camelbacks, Bargeboard, and Toxic Mold Kevin reveals the plans and model of the proposed work to her shotgun single; the plan calls for a camelback addition that will house a master suite, and also a new family room with back and side porches to take advantage of the cool river breezes.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E19 New Orleans: French Quarter, Shotgun Colors Exploring how one of the most important neighborhoods in America fared during the storm; work on the side porch is underway at the project house; stripping paint from the historic windows that will be reused on the project.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E20 New Orleans: Saints in the City Branford Marsalis shows Kevin around and introduces him to saxophonist Calvin Johnson; landscape architect Brian Sublette starts working with Rashida on her yard; Richard Trethewey shows Norm the plumbing layout; Norm and Kevin help install windows.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E15 NASA; Simulated Panels Tom is in Cincinnati to create a simulated wainscoting out of base cap molding; NASA astronaut Mike Foreman shows off a few space tools; Richard helps a homeowner get enough hot water for his children's bath time.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E16 Built It; Downlights Tom and Kevin use scrap wood to create an end grain cutting board in Build It; Scott installs surface-mounted downlights in a living room; What Is It?; Roger discusses the best ways to keep mice out of the house.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E17 Light Lift; Kentucky Lawn Care Scott helps a homeowner raise and lower a light with a motorized lift; Tom shows Kevin the best uses for a jigsaw and how to choose blades; Roger visits Kentucky to help a homeowner repair his once lush lawn.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E18 Passage Set; Landscape Tom helps a homeowner install a new door knob passage set on his closet door; Richard gives a history lesson about plumbing and shows off new toilet technology; Jenn uses a historic landscape design as inspiration to revive an overgrown backyard.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

(Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2021-10-16

The relentless bodyguard and manipulative assassin have been on the opposite end of the bullet for years and are thrown together for a wildly outrageous 24 hours. During their journey from England to the Hague, they encounter high-speed car chases, outlandish boat escapades and a merciless Eastern European dictator who is out for blood. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2017-08-18

moviesphere.us.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
moviesphere.us.description: Bodyguard Michael Bryce and hitman Darius Kincaid are back for another life-threatening mission; still unlicensed and under scrutiny, Bryce is forced into action by Darius's even more volatile wife; soon, all three are in over their heads when a madman's sinister plot threatens to leave Europe in total chaos. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2021-06-16

moviesphere.us.title: Long Shot
moviesphere.us.description: Fred Flarsky is a gifted and free-spirited journalist who has a knack for getting into trouble. Charlotte Field is one of the most influential women in the world -- a smart, sophisticated and accomplished politician. When Fred unexpectedly runs into Charlotte, he soon realizes that she was his former baby sitter and childhood crush. When Charlotte decides to make a run for the presidency, she impulsively hires Fred as her speechwriter -- much to the dismay of her trusted advisers. (Comedy, Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2019-03-09

moviesphere.us.title: A Simple Favor
moviesphere.us.description: Stephanie is a widowed single mother who works as a vlogger in Connecticut. Her best friend, Emily, seems to have it all, a successful career, a loving family and a glamorous lifestyle. When Emily mysteriously disappears one day, Stephanie launches her own investigation by digging into her friend's past, finding a few surprises along the way. (Dark comedy, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2018-09-14

moviesphere.us.title: American Ultra
moviesphere.us.description: Small-town stoner Mike Howell (Jesse Eisenberg) spends most of his time getting high and writing a graphic novel. What Mike doesn't know is that he was trained by the CIA to be a lethal killing machine. When the agency targets him for termination, his former handler activates his latent skills, turning the mild-mannered slacker into a deadly weapon. Now, the utterly surprised Mike must use his newfound abilities to save himself and his girlfriend from getting smoked. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2015-08-21

moviesphere.us.title: Detective Knight: Rogue
moviesphere.us.description: Mask-wearing robbers critically wound Detective James Knight's partner during a shootout. As Knight pursues the bandits from Los Angeles to New York, his dark past collides with his present case, threatening to tear his world apart. (Action, Holiday, Movie, Thriller) - 2022-10-21

paranormalfiles.us.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
paranormalfiles.us.description: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ultimate Japan
spectrumoc16.us.description: Skyler skis at Shiga Kogen in Nagano. Learning about the snow monkeys at Jigokudani. Experiencing more tie-dyeing in Nagoya. Trying the specialty foods in Nagano and Nagoya.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Dut's Grindz & Goodtimes ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Join Dut Leandro and his celebrity guests as they cook, fish, play music and always find good grinds.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Pet Hui
spectrumoc16.us.description: Adoptable canines take over including precious puppies and Chilli, an adorable Airedale/Heeler mix.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Da Braddahs & Friends
spectrumoc16.us.description: James Roache and Tony Silva are the duo known as Da Braddahs. Their show, "Da Braddahs and Friends", takes local comedy to another level with their wild antics and unforgettable characters.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Goes Fishing
spectrumoc16.us.description: Ricky Tsue shares his secrets to catching oama for bait, and using them to go after papio. Kevin Sakuda shows us how a 3-prong spear is made. Family fishing aboard the Hanamana in Kona. Plus, an Okinawan dish and servicing a trailer wheel bearing.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Flhi Girlz

spectrumoc16.us.title: Showcase Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Put a little paradise on your finger with the Puanani Plumeria Ring. A vibrant, realistic enamel plumeria pops against the polished gold-plated setting for a cheerful island-inspired look. 3/4-inch in diameter. Available in sizes 4-9.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Champ Show
spectrumoc16.us.description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cookin' With Cutty
spectrumoc16.us.description: After a long day working with the Yard2Table Foundation gathering reclaimed wood, building raised garden beds and delivering the goods to those in need, Cutty and the gang make ice-cold, homemade vegan soup - Gazpacho.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Manifold Destiny

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - MoSparring

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - The Hills Have Eyes on a Superbird

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Put Me In, Coach

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - How to Cook a Barracuda

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Hell Hath No '58 Fury
speedvision.us.description: The team finishes work on the 340 Cuda and installs panels on the Hemi Charger; Alyssa learns about O.E.M. assembly line markings; a 1958 Plymouth Fury is featured in the film "Christine." (Reality, Auto, How-to) - 2015-10-21

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - 400 Magnum Misfire
speedvision.us.description: The team has difficulty procuring aftermarket parts for their 400 Magnum engine; Allyssa leaves the office and enters the shop; the ghouls disassemble two rare Mopars, including a high-priced convertible. (Reality, Auto, How-to) - 2015-10-28

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Return of the '70 Sunroof Challenger
speedvision.us.description: Mark's addiction is revealed; the 1970 Sunroof Challenger makes a shocking return; the ghouls begin work on the 1970, Plum Crazy, 440, 6-pack and Challenger.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - '70 Cuda Grace
speedvision.us.description: The restoration of the 1970 'Cuda 340 is followed as Mark and the Ghouls struggle to overcome problems with the vehicle's engine.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Hemi Orange Is the New Corporate Blue
speedvision.us.description: The ghouls start work on Bill Goldberg's '68 GTX; Mark repairs a Challenger decklid with bad body work; Will paints Brett Torino's '67 Hemi GTX and challenges Mark to a paint-off.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Grand Theft Hemi
speedvision.us.description: Alyssa is taught how to analyze and document three cars before they are disassembled; the 400 Magnum is installed in the 1972 Dodge Charger; Alyssa commits a crime that Mark may never forgive.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Investigation O.E.
speedvision.us.description: Mark and Tony D'Agostino pick apart, analyze and argue over some of the world's rarest Mopars; a decision must be made about whether to restore a Daytona survivor or leave it in its original state.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Chally vs. Chally
speedvision.us.description: The team completely restores the 1970 Plum Crazy 440 Dodge Challenger V-Code; looking at a side-by-side comparison of the vehicle against the 2014 Dodge Challenger.

speedvision.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Hemi FK5 Alive
speedvision.us.description: Restoration on the burnt orange 1970 Dodge Charger R/T includes the tear-down, body work, paint, assembly-line markings, drive-train installation and the first firing of the vehicle's Hemi engine in over 33 years.

speedvision.us.title: Rutter's Detailin' Garage - Daily Driver Transformation Part 1
speedvision.us.description: Nick Rutter provides tips and techniques for how to detail an engine bay, deep clean wheels and tires, paint decontamination, and headlight restoration on a 10-year-old daily driver.

speedvision.us.title: Rutter's Detailin' Garage - Daily Driver Transformation Part 2
speedvision.us.description: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to restore the finish of a 10-year-old vehicle using a rotary and dual action polisher, protecting with a graphene ceramic coating and also restores the faded plastic trim.

speedvision.us.title: Two Guys Garage - More Fun With a Gen 1
speedvision.us.description: The Gen 1 Camaro is back in the shop, and the guys still have much work remaining in order to finish the build.

speedvision.us.title: Two Guys Garage - WeatherTech Racing
speedvision.us.description: Kevin gets a backstage look at WeatherTech's race team and its North Carolina racing facility.

speedvision.us.title: Two Guys Garage - Dang' Mustang
speedvision.us.description: The guys install a stiffer suspension on a Mustang to help get it ready for power adders, and they toss on a new exhaust to sweeten its sound.

speedvision.us.title: Two Guys Garage - Beat Up Blazer
speedvision.us.description: Willie and Kevin freshen up a rough-looking Chevy Blazer with paint and a new front fascia; they also fix a starting issue and get it running right again.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Mid-Century Poolside Retreat Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Uxmal
truehistory.us.description: Discovering what makes Uxmal a marvel of Maya urban planning; Dr. Barnhart explores archeological features, including the Pyramid of the Dwarf, the Palace of the Governors and the Nunnery Quadrangle; exploring the Loltun Caves. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Celestún
truehistory.us.description: Looking at Kabah, where one will find over 200 faces of Chaac the rain god and a rare example of literate public art; visiting Becal, famous for producing some of the best jipijapas in the Yucatán; taking a trip to the Celestun biosphere. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Labná
truehistory.us.description: Labna is an architectural wonder crowned by three buildings, which are the Palacio, the El Mirador pyramid and the Labna Arch; decoding the cultural messages in these famous works; traveling back to Merida. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Discoveries and Their Significance
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the Dead Sea Scrolls and their discovery; ancient Judaism and early Christianity prior to the scrolls; the uncovering of the scrolls and how they alter one's understanding of every aspect of the historical period of their creation. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The First Seven Scrolls
truehistory.us.description: Diving into a tale of excitement and adventure and discovering more about how scholars gain access to the first seven scrolls discovered at Qumran; what they find when they begin to translate the extraordinary initial discoveries. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - Opening and Reading the First Scroll
truehistory.us.description: Immersing into the text of the scrolls, starting with the scroll known as the Community Rule or Manual of Discipline; the important text that gives one the first insight into the community and theology of the scrolls' creators and guardians. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Historical Backdrop of Ancient Judaism
truehistory.us.description: Examining history prior to the scrolls, beginning with the biblical period and moving to the Maccabean revolt; the arrival of the Romans; King Herod's reign; the life of Jesus; the Zealot revolt; the destruction of Jerusalem and the fall of Masada. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Rise of the Jewish Sects
truehistory.us.description: Jewish sectarianism in late antiquity; focusing on the Sadducees, Pharisees, Essenes and Zealots through Josephus, the Jewish philosopher Philo and the authors of the New Testament books; the later rabbis; Roman polymath Pliny the Elder. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Dead Sea Site of the Qumran Sect
truehistory.us.description: Visiting the isolated region of Qumran's caves; learning how archeological excavations of a nearby ruin help scholars form the most accepted hypothesis of who writes the scrolls and why the scrolls are deposited in the caves. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Emergence of the Rabbinic System
truehistory.us.description: Stepping forward in time and examining some later rabbinic texts from the third century; the rise of the rabbinical tradition; vital perspectives on the composition of the Dead Sea Scrolls. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - A Dead Sea Scroll from Medieval Cairo
truehistory.us.description: Two copies of the Damascus Document are discovered in a Cairo synagogue in the 1890s; although the copies are medieval, the texts are believed to be ancient, a conclusion later confirmed when fragments of the same texts are found at Qumran. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - Medieval Beginnings: The Fall of Empires
truehistory.us.description: Turbulent events that marked the beginning of the Middle Ages. (World history) - 2022-04-22

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - Constantinople, Aksum, and Tang China
truehistory.us.description: Joyce E. Salisbury provides insight into the relationship between sophisticated medieval cities and their supporters. (World history) - 2022-04-22

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - The Rise of Islam and Europe's Knights
truehistory.us.description: The expansion of Islam and how people fared under Muslim rule. (World history) - 2022-04-22

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - Creating an Islamic Culture
truehistory.us.description: The cultural transformations that Muslim rule brought to its domains. (World history) - 2022-04-22

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - The Vikings in Medieval History
truehistory.us.description: Hostile Christian sources demonize the Vikings; Muslim accounts render them exotic; revisionist historians belittle the Norse raids; archeological finds combined with a study of the Norse sagas enrich the understanding of Scandinavia's medieval past. (Educational, History) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - Land and People of Medieval Scandinavia
truehistory.us.description: Scandinavia's landscape shapes its culture; dense forestation leads to close-knit communities; woodworking and sailing are the key means of long-distance travel; harsh winters engender skill in cold-weather commute; the emergence of great halls. (Educational, History) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - Scandinavian Society in the Bronze Age
truehistory.us.description: The physical evidence paints a picture of the Bronze Age in Scandinavia; Viking ancestors trade Arctic goods, amber and slaves in exchange for foreign copper and tin; new wealth fosters larger villages; the beginnings of the Norse pantheon. (Educational, History) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - Scandinavia in the Celtic and Roman Ages
truehistory.us.description: Scandinavia survives on trade with the Celts; contact with Rome enriches the upper classes; Scandinavians returning from Roman military service bring back advanced weapons and armor; petty kings and the first Scandinavian sailing ships emerge. (Educational, History) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - The Lure of the City
truehistory.us.description: Cities are integral to modern lives; why wandering ancient humans leave the forests and plains to create settlements; the fundamental question of "why" is the first step toward understanding the inhabitants and lessons from ancient cities. (World history) - 2014-08-29

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living
truehistory.us.description: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Çatalhöyük's family housing, murals and religious shrines. (World history) - 2014-08-29

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Jericho and Its Walls
truehistory.us.description: The story of the walls of Jericho in the Book of Joshua; looking past the biblical story; what architectural remains suggest about Jericho, whose ritual spaces help create a community and whose walls help define the urban environment.

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Uruk - City of Gilgamesh
truehistory.us.description: Looking at one of the most marvelous cities in the ancient world; Uruk exhibits many of the hallmarks of ancient civilization; division of labor among its craftsmen; a class hierarchy that includes professional priests; records of art and literature.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - The World of Late Antiquity
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the origin of the term late antiquity; why this historical view better reflects the period from the third to the eighth centuries than the traditional view that Rome has a decline and fall; the major themes and issues of the course.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - The Crisis of the 3rd Century
truehistory.us.description: The crisis of the third century, when Rome finds its frontiers threatened on several fronts; armies make and unmake emperors with alarming regularity; the literature of the period also reveals unmistakable feelings of despair and uncertainty.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - The New Empire of Diocletian
truehistory.us.description: No one predicts that Rome is about to raise two of its greatest rulers, Diocletian and Constantine; Diocletian institutes a series of reforms that divide the empire into east and west; launching the last and fiercest persecution of Christians.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - Constantine's Roman Revolution
truehistory.us.description: Turning to Constantine; how he extends Diocletian's reforms; among them, he gives the empire a new capital at Byzantium, which he renames Constantinople after himself; he also takes the surprising step of legalizing Christianity.

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
truehistory.us.description: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Mayas, Aztecs, and Incas
truehistory.us.description: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics.

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Europeans and Africans
truehistory.us.description: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa.

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - 1990: America's New World Order
truehistory.us.description: The end of the Cold War is a key point in history; the rapid collapse of the Soviet Union; the fall of the Berlin Wall; delving into the American story in the early 1990s; conflicts in Kuwait and Bosnia test America's new role in a post-Soviet world.

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - The Clintons and the 1990s
truehistory.us.description: Bill Clinton's presidency dominates the domestic news in the 1990s. From his dramatic showdown with Newt Gingrich and the Republican Congress's Contract with America, this is a presidency of high drama; surveying the tumultuous decade.

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - A New Millennium, George W. Bush, and 9/11
truehistory.us.description: The end of the Cold War may have reshaped the world order, but 9/11 and the subsequent war on terror changes America; tracing the events leading up to the terrorist attack on American soil on Sept. 11, 2001; learning why 19 hijackers attack America.

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - The US Wars in Afghanistan and Iraq
truehistory.us.description: Historians discuss and debate the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq; the war in Afghanistan has some justification, given the role of Al-Qaeda in 9/11; Professor Allitt reviews the facts surrounding the war in Iraq; the war's effect on the United States.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - An Overview of Democracy in America
truehistory.us.description: The course begins with a brief overview of Tocqueville's masterwork; written to educate the French about democracy; it is originally published as two separate volumes, released five years apart.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - Alexis de Tocqueville-A Brief Biography
truehistory.us.description: William R. Cook introduces the young French nobleman, trained as a lawyer; his most famous book is only one achievement in a life marked by several; service as France's foreign minister; a history of the French Revolution regarded as a classic.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - The Journey to America
truehistory.us.description: Tocqueville rarely describes specific events or conversations; his letters and journals allow one to follow him on his trip; getting an excellent feel for the experiences he and his colleague, Gustave de Beaumont, have in America.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - Equality of Conditions and Freedom
truehistory.us.description: This lecture considers the meaning and implications of what Tocqueville introduces in the first paragraph of "Democracy in America"; the foundation of the democratic enterprise; the concept he calls equality of conditions.

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - 1865: "Bind Up the Nation's Wounds"
truehistory.us.description: The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War.

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - The Reconstruction Revolution
truehistory.us.description: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: It's all about the maintenance this week at Longmeadow, as Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants. Joe Swift and Adam Frost meet up in Leicestershire to see how they can help a couple of novice gardeners turn a neglected area of their garden into a useable and useful space. Nick Bailey goes to Ham House in Richmond to see how they are coping with the ravages of box tree caterpillar and Arit Anderson visits a garden in Suffolk to find out about the concept of rewilding.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty catches up with summer maintenance in his wildlife garden and recommends plants for deep, dry shade under trees, as well as giving advice on what to plant now for late summer harvests.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team focus their attention on the loss of wildflower habitats in the UK and the part that gardeners can play in averting the resulting loss of wildlife. Adam Frost is in Lincolnshire to find out how crucial meadows are to supporting an ecosystem.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty explains how to produce a medley of vegetables from a small space. He also lifts and divides irises plus adds spires of summer colour to his borders. Carol Klein is inspired by the summer planting at Wollerton Old Hall in Shropshire and Frances Tophill travels to the Isle of Man to visit an allotment where plants are grown and harvested as ingredients for cosmetics.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The team are out and about this week in Birmingham at the annual Gardeners' World Live show. Monty Don, Joe Swift and Adam Frost bring us design tips from the show gardens, Carol Klein seeks out the best plants in the floral marquee, Frances Tophill, Nick Bailey, Arit Anderson and Mark Lane look at inspirational planting ideas and the show helps visitors solve their gardening and planting problems.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Amid the cocaine wars of early 1980's Miami, three dead bodies led a multi-agency tactical squad to suspect that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. Investigating rumors of corruption, the squad uncovered a ring of patrolmen who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine. The investigators set out to prove that even with the advantages wealth and the protection of a police badge, nobody is above the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A man is found suffocated in his Pennsylvania home, his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle appear to have been stolen. Fingerprints from the victim identify a recent escapee from a minimum-security prison, as well as his girlfriend. Investigators flag the dead man's credit cards, and are alerted when one is used in North Dakota. The FBI is called in and joins another task force already assembled because of a suspected kidnapping.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Wisconsin, a varsity athlete is blindfolded, gagged, and shoved into a van by four gunmen. The kidnappers contact the victim's family and demand $30,000, but offer no instructions on how to transfer the money. The victim's family contacts the police. The boy's captors tell his family they have shot him, and will kill him if they do not receive their money. At an agreed upon drop site, FBI agents approach the captor's vehicle, only to watch them flee and quickly be followed by authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A New Jersey State Trooper is shot to death on the side of Interstate 80 near the Pennsylvania border. Witnesses to the shooting identify the shooter's car. Police issue an APB, and locate the vehicle hours later. Fingerprinting of the vehicle points to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges. Authorities who inspect the fugitive's home find some incriminating evidence including a box of bullets linked to the Trooper's murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: An Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed after pulling over a van for a traffic violation. Officers apprehend the shooter, after a car chase and shootout. ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Four inmates from a Delaware Correctional Center turn up missing in the middle of the night. A few hours later, a stolen vehicle is recovered; inside, one of the inmate's fingerprints is found, as well as the address book of one of the other fugitives. A multi-state manhunt ensues with the help of the FBI. A nearby robbery report is the agent's first tip, followed by a murder in the same neighborhood.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the Spring of 1997, a killer preying on senior citizens terrorizes the River Parish area of Southern Louisiana. By May, local police and the New Orleans FBI are exploring a connection between the April 9 murder of a 71-year old widow and the May 9 murder of a retired couple. A month later, authorities forward information on the crimes to the FBI's Behavioral Science Unit in Quantico, VA, hoping a profile will help them narrow the field of possible suspects.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On December 21, 1998, two gunmen kidnap three janitors on their way to clean the Bank of America ATM repository in Las Vegas. The gunmen force the janitors to let them in the ATM repository and hold them hostage until the armored car guards arrive to make their nightly collection. When the guards enter the bank, the gunmen surprise them and shoot one guard in the chest before escaping with $1,088,000, the largest bank robbery take in Las Vegas history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Henderson, NV, a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambush armored guards as they exit their truck on March 3, 2000. The robbers kill both guards and seize $5,000. As the killers run to their getaway car, a police officer arrives and opens fire, striking one escaping assailant in the leg. After loosing the killers in a chase, police collect blood left by the injured robber and bullet casings from the firefight.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 12, 1997, two men use a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, NJ home. The homeowner shoots at the intruders, hitting one in the hand before they escape. Camden Police respond and track the suspects to a nearby park. One of the men shoots at the officer before police arrest his accomplice. The man gives up the identity of the shooter. Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When violent criminals strike, the FBI strikes back, employing every available resource, and creating new ones when necessary. From forensic science to criminal profiling, specialized intelligence to global fugitive tracking, the agents of the FBI battle the bad guys with a most powerful arsenal: the crime-fighter's toolbox. This special episode of The FBI Files celebrates the groundbreaking science, investigative technique, and gut-level instinct that has made the FBI the world's premier law enforcement agency.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1970's, Otpor, a violent arm of the Croatian National Resistance commits terroristic acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the U.S. With the help of an informant, the FBI is able to apprehend, arrest and convict members of the group for crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area. The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders. Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes. The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors. All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence. FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 70s and early 80s, a terrorist group known as the FALN is suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities. Their goal - to bring attention to the Puerto Rican independence movement. As the bombings escalate, innocent lives are lost. FBI agents and police are is in a deadly race to stop this murderous group with a dangerous cause.

sportsman.ca.title: Ducks Unlimited Red Oaks For Mallards Part 2

677011.title: Hell's Kitchen
677011.description: At Animo Venice Charter High School, Ramsay surprises the final five with high school photos of themselves. Each chef must cook a unique dish in forty minutes.

677011.title: MasterChef
677011.description: After a dramatic elimination, the remaining 17 home cooks are greeted by Chef Ramsay and Tosi, as well as special guests Season Six winner Claudia Sandoval and guest culinary judge Aaron Sanchez, as they reveal the next mystery box challenge. Each contestant will have 60 minutes to create his/her own unique dish using a number of Sandoval’s favorite ingredients. The winner of the challenge will not only be safe from the next elimination round, but will also help in deciding the fate of three other contestants in the elimination. Find out who is saved and who survives elimination.

677011.title: MasterChef
677011.description: This week, the remaining 16 home cooks get a very special treat leading into the next challenge, as Chef Ramsay demonstrates how to properly deconstruct a lobster. They will then each have 25 minutes to kill, poach and shell a lobster, just as they learned from the master, and the winner will have the advantage of choosing which team he or she will join for the next field challenge. For the second part of the challenge, Chef Ramsay demonstrates how to make lobster tortellini in a seafood broth. The contestants have 45 minutes to recreate Ramsay’s dish. Find out who survives elimination.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree his character.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men, until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. On board is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The lazy Jackman brothers mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a pretty young stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's two older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight them both.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople are unfriendly to them, making fun of their clothing and customs. The Argentinean adult immigrant is openly hostile in return.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax after they adopt a stray horse whose owner has been killed in a gunfight.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: After the end of the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan, who has been appointed Governor of the New Mexico Territory, is on an inspection tour of the country.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration. When the drunken crowd gets out of hand and roughs up the bride-to-be, the young groom challenges them.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a young boy from Brooklyn is accused of murder, Mark, believing the boy's claim of innocence, hides him until he can find the real killer.

673500.title: The Awful Truth
673500.description: Jerry (Cary Grant) and Lucy (Irene Dunne) are a married couple who doubt each other's fidelity: Jerry suspects Lucy and her music teacher (Alexander D'Arcy) of spending an evening together, and Lucy is convinced Jerry lied about a business trip. When the jealous pair file for divorce, both rush into new relationships, but quickly realize their love never died. The soon-to-be-divorced husband and wife then both scramble to spoil each other's chances for newfound romance.

673500.title: You Can't Run Away From It
673500.description: A spoiled heiress teams up with an enterprising reporter to escape her domineering father's plan of keeping her from getting married.

673500.title: It Happened One Night
673500.description: When a brash reporter starts trailing a runaway heiress on her bus trip from Florida to New York for a big scoop, can love be far behind?

673500.title: Hot Blood
673500.description: A gypsy woman who lives by decamping with marriage settlements from wealthy men meets her match in the handsome younger brother of a gypsy king.

673500.title: Our Wife
673500.description: A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

673500.title: The Undercover Man
673500.description: Determined Treasury Department investigator Frank Warren (Glenn Ford) goes after a ruthless mobster known as The Big Fellow. When a key informant is murdered, Warren pursues the gangster on charges of tax evasion. But, with a slick mob lawyer hampering him at every turn, and threats being lobbed toward Warren's wife (Nina Foch), the lawman's chances of achieving a conviction are slim to none. His only hope is that one syndicate bookkeeper will have the courage to turn state's evidence.

673500.title: Boston Blackie and the Law

673500.title: It Happened to Jane
673500.description: When a shipment of expired shellfish arrives to her New England lobstery, Jane Osgood decides to take a capitalist railroad tycoon to court.

673498.description: Brazos Kane, a gunslinger who's vowed to kill no more, goes to work for a land baron on a ranch, where he is unjustly accused of murder.

673498.title: Oklahoma Crude
673498.description: In 1913 Oklahoma, a wildcat oil driller reluctantly accepts help from her estranged father and a drifter as she resists pressure to sell her land.

673498.title: Unknown Valley
673498.description: Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.

673498.title: Go West, Young Girl!
673498.description: New England writer Netty (Karen Valentine) and cavalry widow Gilda (Sandra Will) team up to find Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Reprisal!
673498.description: Frank Madden (Guy Madison), who is part Native American but passes as white, purchases a ranch in the small town of Kendall, Okla. When Frank moves in, he finds that the bigoted townspeople have recently let three brothers, who are also his neighbors, get away with the lynching murder of innocent Native Americans. As tensions between the townspeople and local Native Americans rise, Hank becomes torn between fighting against injustice and keeping his true identity a secret.

673498.title: Forbidden Trail
673498.description: A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.

673498.title: The Professionals
673498.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement.

673498.title: The California Trail
673498.description: Cowboy Santa Fe Stewart (Buck Jones) fights a tyrant in Spanish California.

673498.title: Count Three and Pray
673498.description: After fighting for the Union during the Civil War, Luke Fargo (Van Heflin) is greeted with resentment when he returns home to his small southern town. Luke has a reputation as a rogue, but he's reinvented himself as a man of God and plans to fix up the town's damaged church. Recalling their romantic past, Georgina Decrais (Allison Hayes) tries to reclaim Luke. But, to the dismay of some suspicious townspeople, he concentrates on mentoring an unsophisticated young woman, Lissy (Joanne Woodward).

673498.title: Jack McCall, Desperado
673498.description: A lone gunslinger, Jack McCall (George Montgomery), bursts into a saloon and shoots dead the legendary Wild Bill Hickok (Douglas Kennedy). Arrested and put on trial, McCall recounts a twisted tale that paints Hickok as anything but heroic, explaining how Hickok and McCall's cousin Bat (James Seay) took over McCall's family's plantation, killed his parents and even framed him for crimes he didn't commit. McCall's cold-blooded killing of Hickok was warranted. Or was it?

673498.title: A Lawless Street
673498.description: The honorable Calem Ware (Randolph Scott), marshal of the Wild West boomtown of Medicine Bend, attempts to defuse the simmering tensions in his rapidly growing and increasingly violent town, as a greedy businessman (Warner Anderson) hires a sinister black-gloved gunman (Michael Pate) to take care of his problems with the marshal for good. Meanwhile, a traveling song-and-dance troupe arrives in town, bearing Ware's lost love, Tally (Angela Lansbury), who holds the secret to his violent past.
